name: TMS OS V15.2.1
notes: V15.2.1: Trang Database tu dong phat hien file SQLite trong website (Typecho, ung dung nguoi dung), xuat SQL va mang ve quan ly duoc tu panel.
features: Database Manager tu dong quet file SQLite (*.sqlite3, *.sqlite, *.db) trong cac website (~/websites), bao gom file Typecho mac dinh trong usr/
Hien thi 2 nhom: Database TMS OS (tao/xuat/nhap/xoa) va Database trong website (xuat SQL + Mang ve quan ly)
Mang database tu website ve thu muc quan ly cua TMS OS (copy an toan, co kiem tra path traversal)
Chi chap nhan file SQLite that (kiem tra header SQLite format 3), loai tru thu muc nang (node_modules, vendor, .git)
Remote Access: truy cap panel tu xa qua Cloudflare Tunnel (panel.<domain>) khong phu thuoc WiFi/LAN (V15.2.0)
